title: Sea Foam Green Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Valet Stand, 5X5 Base, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Sea Foam Green, paper towel holder for kitchen countertops with 14-inch height (14 inches, 14-inch) and a 5 in x 5 in base (5x5), which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. Freestanding paper towel stand / paper towel valet requires no wall mounting; place it on the counter to keep a roll within reach. Solid brass construction with a weighted base to help prevent tipping, plus a felt pad to help prevent scratching on surfaces. Contemporary, modern style for crisp, clean kitchens and minimalist spaces. Designer finish is built for corrosion-free, rust-free performance, and the holder is available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes. Includes: paper towel holder. No assembly required. Dimensions: 5 in L x 14 in H x 5 in W; weight 4.8 lb. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
